oracle.name: Dataverse Web API
oracle.scope: Two hosted runs (A, B) of eleven designer calculated columns on one table, Solution-exported FormulaDefinition XAML (arithmetic, IF / ELSE IF / ELSE, IF without ELSE, SelectFirstNonNull-wrapped literals, AddDays, DiffInDays, divide by zero, precision 2, a one-hop parent field, Concat, Boolean and choice results): reads of eight seeded rows, a write of a source column, a direct write to a calculated column, and $filter / $orderby on a calculated column. Schema names, option values and row names are invented equivalents; ids, annotations and creation times are not compared (the creation date is). The exact hosted build is unrecorded.
